    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AnnotationMetadata
    The framework-related annotations captured at an injection point or provision definition: every annotation whose type carries InjectingAnnotation, QualifyingAnnotation, or ScopingAnnotation.
    AnnotationValue
    One annotation captured at compile time: its type, its member values, and the framework stereotypes it carries.
    Assisted
    Marks a caller-supplied parameter of an assisted recipe: an @Inject constructor or @Provides method containing one becomes reachable only through an AssistedFactory method, which supplies these parameters at call time while the container resolves the rest.
    AssistedFactory
    Marks a factory-interface method the annotation processor implements.
    BeanDefinition
    A read-only view of a registered bean: its primary key, the framework annotations declared on it, and its injection points.
    ChildContext
    A child Context: nearest-ancestor local bindings first (walking up through any intermediate ChildContexts), then the parent.
    CircularDependencyException
    Thrown when a dependency cycle is detected at resolution time.
    Condition
    Decides whether a bean carrying a given conditioning annotation is registered.
    ConditionalOnProperty
    Registers the annotated bean only when a property matches.
    ConditionContext
    The environment a Condition evaluates against.
    ConditioningAnnotation
    Meta-annotation marking an annotation as a registration condition.
    ConditionResolutionException
    Thrown when a conditioning annotation has no registered Condition, or more than one.
    ConstructionListener
    Observes the instances the container builds.
    ConstructorInjectionPoint
    The constructor injection point of a bean.
    Context
    The internal resolution engine.
    Contribution
    A factory's collection membership: instead of binding under its own keys, the factory's bean joins the collection bound at collectionKey.
    Default
    Marks a Provides method as the fallback recipe for its key: the binding is used only when no other live binding satisfies the same key.
    DefaultContext
    Default Context: loads all Factory and Scope services, wraps each factory provider with a cycle guard and its declared scope, checks that every live bean's dependencies are bound, and resolves keys lazily.
    DuplicateBindingException
    Thrown when two factories expose the same Key.
    Eager
    Marks a Singleton bean, or a Provides method returning a singleton, to be built when the root injector is created rather than on first resolution.
    ExposeAs
    Narrows the keys a bean is exposed under to exactly the listed types, replacing the default (the bean type plus all of its supertypes).
    Factory<T>
    Base class for per-bean factories.
    FactoryProvider<T>
    A Provider that builds instances by invoking a Factory with a Context.
    FieldInjectionPoint
    A field injection point.
    Inject
    Marks a constructor, method, or field as an injection point.
    InjectingAnnotation
    Meta-annotation marking an annotation as a plugin-handled injecting annotation.
    InjectionException
    Base type for all runtime injection failures.
    InjectionPoint
    Metadata describing where dependencies are injected, for inspection and resolution.
    InjectionSite
    An injection site offered to an InjectPlugin — a field, or a constructor/method parameter.
    Injector
    The user-facing entry point for obtaining instances and providers.
    Injector.Builder
    Builds an Injector that overlays explicit instance bindings on top of the discovered graph.
    Injector.ChildBuilder
    Builds a child Injector: explicit instance and provider bindings layered over the parent's graph.
    InjectPlugin
    Extension point for the annotation processor, discovered via ServiceLoader.
    InterceptedMethod
    An intercepted method's immutable call-site description: what the method is, and which annotations bind interceptors to it, outermost first.
    InterceptingAnnotation
    Meta-annotation marking an annotation as an interception trigger.
    InterceptionException
    Thrown when an interceptor throws something the intercepted method does not declare, or returns an illegal value.
    InterceptorResolutionException
    Thrown when an intercepting annotation is in use but no bean is annotated Intercepts for it.
    Intercepts
    Marks a bean as the MethodInterceptor handling one intercepting annotation.
    IntoMap
    Contributes the annotated bean (or @Provides result) to the Map<String, value> binding under IntoMap.key(), instead of binding it under its own keys.
    IntoSet
    Contributes the annotated bean (or @Provides result) to the Set<value> binding instead of binding it under its own keys.
    Joinpoint
    The innermost hop of an interceptor chain: the call to the bean's own implementation.
    Key<T>
    A binding identity: a Type optionally combined with a qualifier annotation.
    MethodInjectionPoint
    A method injection point.
    MethodInterception
    A context-bound interceptor chain for one intercepted method: the call site plus one provider per binding, in order.
    MethodInterceptor
    Runs around an intercepted method call.
    MethodInvocation
    One intercepted call, as seen by one interceptor.
    Named
    Built-in string qualifier.
    Names
    Factories for built-in qualifier annotation instances.
    OnPropertyCondition
    Built-in Condition for ConditionalOnProperty.
    Parameter
    Describes one constructor or method parameter to inject.
    PostConstruct
    Marks the method invoked once the bean is fully injected — after constructor, @Inject methods, and @Inject fields.
    PreDestroy
    Marks the method invoked when the owning injector closes: for a bean of a child-local scope, the child injector that hosts it.
    Provider<T>
    The core abstraction: supplies an instance of T on demand.
    Provides
    Marks a method that supplies an instance of its return type.
    QualifyingAnnotation
    Meta-annotation marking an annotation as a qualifier (contributes to a Key).
    Scope
    Wraps a provider to give it a lifecycle.
    ScopedProduct
    The product of an assisted factory method whose recipe has a child-local scope.
    ScopeResolutionException
    Thrown when a scope cannot apply: more than one Scope for a scoping annotation, a bean of a child-local scope resolved where no injector hosts that scope, or a child-local bean contributing to a collection.
    ScopingAnnotation
    Meta-annotation marking an annotation as a scope selector.
    Singleton
    Built-in scope: exactly one instance per injector.
    SingletonProvider<T>
    Wraps a provider so its delegate is invoked exactly once; every SingletonProvider.get() returns the same instance.
    SingletonScope
    The built-in Singleton scope: memoizes the wrapped provider.
    TypeLiteral<T>
    Represents a generic type T.
    Types
    Factories for the parameterized Types used as collection binding keys.
    UnsatisfiedDependencyException
    Thrown when no factory can satisfy a requested Key.
